t: From Fanciful Flight to Funnel: Architecting AI Workflows with Pipulate
s: This article details Pipulate's methodology for transforming diffuse AI capabilities into structured, high-impact workflows, using the 'desert kite' analogy to funnel AI power. It emphasizes cloning successful patterns, like the transition from FAQuilizer to URLinspector, for exponential productivity gains by bridging intuitive conceptualization with pragmatic implementation.
sub: Desert kite analogy for AI funneling
Cloning successful AI patterns (FAQuilizer to URLinspector)
Bridging right-brain conceptualization and left-brain implementation
Optimism as an AI engine and positive feedback loops
